paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three metrics: Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment, for Llama3-8B on Basketball. The X-axis, labeled "Question Popularity," has a linear scale, ranging from 5.0 to 25.0, with evenly spaced numerical labels at intervals of 2.5. The Y-axis, labeled "Values," also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with labels at intervals of 0.2.

The graph contains three lines, each representing one of the metrics. The Accuracy line is blue, with a solid style and circular markers, starting at approximately 0.1 when the question popularity is 5.0 and increasing to around 0.28 at a question popularity of 25.0, with a noticeable steeper rise after a popularity of 15.0. The Confidence line is green, also with a solid style and triangular markers, beginning at about 0.55 at a question popularity of 5.0 and rising to approximately 0.75 at a popularity of 25.0, with a slight dip between popularities of 7.5 and 10.0. The Alignment line is red, with a solid style and square markers, starting at around 0.53 at a question popularity of 5.0, experiencing a slight decrease to about 0.5 at a popularity of 10.0, before gradually increasing to approximately 0.57 at a popularity of 25.0.
